sources.title: 赵江红《星平合参：域外星命术的本土化路径》2023《宋史研究论丛》论文摘要
sources.provider: 《宋史研究论丛》期刊第一方内容展示平台（知网期刊界面）
sources.quality_notes: 2023(03) pp123-137 DOI 10.16764/b.cnki.ssyjlc.2023.0082. First-party abstract claims Song natal astral texts integrated Western zodiacal/planetary materials and some Four Pillars shensha/geju, with compilations. Full article available only via external CNKI route and NOT read. Does NOT establish Ziwei fourteen-main-star lineage, direct rule/plate borrowing or Song date for modern Ziwei. Treat all abstract claims as modern scholarly thesis and discovery pointers.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: A modern historiographical title/TOC cannot date an ancient rule's first attestation.
2023 Song astral/Four-Pillars mixing thesis is not evidence of later fourteen-main-star Ziwei Dou Shu genealogy.
Same characters for 年主/日主 or 始年/日干 across independent received texts do not imply a universal single-step linear school transition.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Edition-bound page collation for Wuxing Jingji Song-to-Ming carriers and Zi Ping YuanYuan texts; dated original source passages for year/day-root coexistence.
Primary evidence needed to connect Song astral palace texts and post-Ming Ziwei traditions, if such a connection exists.
